job.title: Master Data Administrator
job.description:
Ready to make a real impact? We're partnering with a leading business to find a Master Data Administartor who thrives at the intersection of systems, data, commercial analysis and continuous improvement.

This is a fantastic opportunity to take ownership of critical product, pricing and configuration data while driving system enhancements that directly influence business performance. If you enjoy solving complex problems, improving processes, and partnering with stakeholders across the business, this could be the role for you.

Key Responsibilities Product & Systems Management
  • Manage product configurations, templates and business rules
  • Maintain product, pricing and specification data across multiple platforms
  • Support new product introductions and lifecycle changes
  • Ensure data accuracy and consistency across integrated systems
Reporting & Commercial Analysis
  • Deliver reporting and insights that support business decision-making
  • Conduct margin, cost variance and pricing analysis
  • Identify trends and opportunities to improve business performance
Continuous Improvement
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve data quality
  • Support system enhancements, integrations and optimisation projects
  • Contribute to initiatives that improve efficiency, governance and user experience
About You

We're looking for someone who combines strong analytical skills with a passion for systems, data and process improvement.

Here is what you will bring:
  • Experience in product configuration, systems administration, master data, ERP or CRM environments
  • Advanced Excel and reporting skills
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Experience managing large and complex datasets
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills
  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset
  • The ability to prioritise competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment
What's in It for You?
  • Join a growing and highly successful organisation
  • Play a key role in shaping products, pricing and business systems
  • Work closely with a broad range of business stakeholders
  • Lead process improvement and system enhancement initiatives
  • Combine data analysis, systems administration and commercial decision-making in one diverse role
  • Enjoy a role with genuine influence and visibility across the business
Highly Regarded Experience with any of the following will be advantageous:
  • Product configuration platforms
  • ERP, purchasing or inventory management systems
  • Salesforce or other CRM platforms
  • Data governance and master data management
  • Pricing, costing or commercial analysis
Why Apply? This is more than a systems administration role. It's an opportunity to become a trusted business partner.

If you're passionate about data, systems, commercial outcomes and continuous improvement, we would love to hear from you. Apply now!
